title: The Best Habit Tracking App Ever!
body:
Very customizable.
Excellent user interface.
You won’t regret using this app.
It only works if you do.
I recommend putting it somewhere where you’re likely to see and click on it(not in an app folder you seldom use).
author: Sis. Hyde

title: Great app
body: Honestly, this is a great app for helping you to build a routine that you can be consistent with. The reminders are always on schedule and help to keep you on track if you may forget what to do. Truly life changing❤️❤️❤️
author: Rash303

title: Beware
body: This is a decent app, just know that you can only have 5 habits at a time on the free version. If you need more, you’ll have to pay.
author: Seymour101

title: Amazing!
body: Honestly it’s the only thing in the last 6 months that’s helped me get my life together. I paid for it after only intending on using the free version (a rarity for me)
author: Tedecia
